insights.concise_text: NeuronBlocks addresses engineers’ productivity challenges with a two-layer solution whose effectiveness was verified by extensive experiments on common NLP tasks.

triple.subject: NeuronBlocks two-layer solution
triple.object: engineers’ productivity challenges

insights.concise_text: The upper layer’s end-to-end network templates correspond to the Model Zoo, which provides JSON configuration files for popular NLP tasks.

triple.subject: upper layer’s end-to-end network templates
triple.object: Model Zoo JSON configuration files

insights.concise_text: The bottom layer’s reusable and standard components correspond to the Block Zoo, whose blocks are supplied to the Model Architecture interface.

triple.subject: bottom layer’s reusable and standard components
triple.object: Block Zoo blocks

insights.concise_text: The survey finding that more than 90% of networks used several common components supports NeuronBlocks’ Block Zoo design of standard and reusable blocks.

triple.subject: more than 90% of networks used several common components
triple.object: Block Zoo standard and reusable blocks

insights.concise_text: The survey finding that about 87.5% NLP related jobs belong to a few common tasks supports NeuronBlocks’ Model Zoo templates for the most popular NLP tasks.

triple.subject: about 87.5% NLP related jobs belong to a few common tasks
triple.object: Model Zoo templates for the most popular NLP tasks

insights.concise_text: NeuronBlocks’ JSON configuration workflow enables users to instantiate Model Zoo templates or construct Block Zoo architectures without coding efforts.

triple.subject: JSON configuration workflow
triple.object: Model Zoo templates or Block Zoo architectures without coding efforts

insights.concise_text: The knowledge distillation template’s goal of improving inference speed is supported by the student model by NeuronBlocks getting 23-27 times inference speedup.

triple.subject: knowledge distillation template
triple.object: inference speed by 23-27 times

insights.concise_text: On CoNLL-2003 BIBREF14 English NER dataset, 12 different combinations of network layers/blocks reproduced original models with comparative or slightly better performance.

triple.subject: 12 different combinations of network layers/blocks
triple.object: CoNLL-2003 BIBREF14 English NER dataset

insights.concise_text: On GLUE benchmark tasks, BiLSTM and Attention based models built by NeuronBlocks achieved competitive or even better results with minimal coding efforts.

triple.subject: BiLSTM and Attention based models built by NeuronBlocks
triple.object: competitive or even better results on GLUE tasks with minimal coding efforts

insights.concise_text: On WikiQA dataset, CNN, BiLSTM, and Attention based models built in NeuronBlocks achieved competitive or even better results with simple model configurations.

triple.subject: CNN, BiLSTM, and Attention based models built in NeuronBlocks
triple.object: competitive or even better results on WikiQA dataset with simple model configurations
